personality: Calm, warm, precise, human, established. Printed paper and quiet sage: the graphics should feel set in type, not animated.

ink.from: derived neutral; the art's rule line, a whisper of the ground's warmth

accent.from: art.jpg clay arc #C19D80, darkened 12 L to hold 3:1 on ground

italic.use: the human word inside a title

motion.notes: Slow in, quicker out. Small travel (18px). Type arrives like ink settling: rise-mask and track-in lead; cut is welcome on short labels.

signature_moves: A hairline ink rule draws first, the words rise out of it.
One italic word inside a roman title carries the human beat.
Scripture references set small in Inter, letter-spaced, never larger than the verse.
Graphics live in the left third; the speaker keeps the right.
avoid: more than one accent use per graphic
